description: Sub-agent registry for the WhyC v4 'PDD on Runtime' pipeline. The pipeline-kickoff orchestrator dispatches by tag — e.g. all agents tagged `stage:analyze` + `role:advocate` for the multi-analyzer fan-out. Each agent is a Gemini call with a persona system prompt; the model tier is part of the registry, not hard-coded in the stage module.

agents.name: The Designer (P18)
agents.bias: editorial / visual storytelling — hero, type scale, rhythm; treats the preview as a piece of design, not a CRUD form

agents.name: The Spreadsheet Jockey (P06)
agents.bias: dense data grid power user — sortable columns, sparklines, keyboard nav; maximise information per pixel

agents.name: The Pragmatist (P11)
agents.bias: ship today — the smallest surface that demonstrates the 3 flows; YAGNI; no speculative structure

agents.name: The Mobile-First (P07)
agents.bias: phone-frame default — 48px tap targets, bottom sheets, single-column flow, thumb-reachable primary action

agents.name: The Data Nerd (P13)
agents.bias: analytics first — KPI strip above the fold, every flow instrumented, the dashboard is the product

agents.name: Analyze Synthesizer
agents.bias: merge the surviving advocate ProductSpec drafts into one coherent 9-field spec; resolve conflicts toward demo-ability; never invent constraints the postings don't support

agents.name: Develop Cross-Picker
agents.bias: pick the single advocate manifest that best realises the spec's 3 flows on one screen; record a verbatim rationale; ties broken toward the manifest with the fewest files (KISS)

agents.name: Critic — Pitch Alignment
agents.bias: does the rendered preview say what the company's posting says it does? penalise generic SaaS template energy

agents.name: Critic — Flows Present
agents.bias: are all 3 spec flows actually reachable and demonstrable in the deployed preview? a flow that 404s scores 0

agents.name: Critic — Design Quality
agents.bias: visual hierarchy, contrast, spacing, type; would a designer wince? polish of the first impression

agents.name: Critic — Implementation
agents.bias: does it actually run? hydration errors, console errors, broken links, layout shift — engineering rigor of the artifact

agents.name: Critic — Security
agents.bias: pass/fail, not a score — does the preview leak anything (keys, internal URLs, PII), echo unsanitised input, or reproduce the company's proprietary IP verbatim? any concern raises security_flag

agents.name: Trace Self-Reader (Phoenix MCP)
agents.bias: read this run's OWN Phoenix traces back via @arizeai/phoenix-client; surface the slowest/erroring spans per flow so self-improve's regen choice is grounded in observability data, not just the judge's text
